3. Ecosystem diversity
The variety of ecosystem in a given region

Ecosystem diversity deals with the variations in ecosystems within a geographical
location and its overall impact on human existence and the environment.

An example of ecological diversity on a global scale would be the variation in ecosystems,
such as deserts, forests, grasslands, wetlands and oceans.

b) Why food web is more important ecologically than the concept of simple 2 2 i
food chain.

(Ans. The transfer of food energy from the producers ( plants ) through a series of organisms
(Herbivores, Carnivores) successively with the repeated activities of eating and being eaten
is known as food chain.

Whereas food web is a network of food chains where different types of organisms are
connected at different trophic levels so that there are a number of options of eating and being
eaten at each trophic level.

So, food webs improve the stability of an ecosystem as it includes all the interconnected
food chains. These webs are important for illustrating the feeding relationships in a
community among the species.

A food chain is a linear sequence of organisms through which food and its contained energy
pass. If one of the organisms number decreases in a linear food chain, next organisms will be
affected due to food shortage.

However, in a food web, each organism has a choice to feed on different types of other

organisms. So, the concept of the food web is more significant that food chain.
6.a) Discuss various values of biodiversity. 3 #1 3
Ans. Various values of biodiversity
(i) Consumptive values,

1 The value of Nature’s Products that are
consumed directly such as firewoods , fodder
and meat.

1 In other words the products which are
consumed directly without passing through
the market

1 Consumptive use value seldom appear in
National income accounts.

(ii) Productive use value

Commercially usable values where the
product is marketed and sold

» Wild Gene Resources — traded for use by
scientists for introducing desirable traits in
the crops and domesticated animals

Many industries are built depending on the productive used value of biodiversity. 2 2 2
For e.g. industries like paper, pulp, plywood, textile, leather, pearl etc.
